name: Kyonyuu Reijou MC Gakuen
source: Ikenoue Takumi, the protagonist, is the only male student who entered the former prestigious girls' school, Okyo Gakuen, as a special scholarship student. Kisshouji Arisa, the highest authority in the school, and her secretary, Kuga Yuriko, were planning to sacrifice the protagonist and control the minds of the female students in the school as the owners of the ideology of female honors. When the protagonist learns that Arisa and Yuriko are the cause of his unreasonable bullying, he steals the magic hypnotic tool, the music box, and attempts revenge.
translation: 主人公池上拓海是前名牌女子学校“王京学园”中唯一一名以特别奖学金生的身份进入的男学生。学校最高权力者吉祥寺亚里沙和她的秘书久我百合子，正计划牺牲主角，以女性荣誉思想的拥有者的身份控制学校女学生的思想。当主角得知亚里沙和百合子是他无理欺凌的原因时，他偷走了魔法催眠工具音乐盒，并试图复仇。
